The '''Renatasia system''' contained the medium-sized yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Renatasia/Legends|Renatasia]] and eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] including [[Renatasia III]] and [[Renatasia IV]]. It was one of the many lost [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonies founded by [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].

In [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]], the colony was rediscovered and [[Osuno Whett/Legends|Osuno Whett]] and [[Vuffi Raa]] were assigned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to win the trust of the Renatasians to make them easy targets for the armed forces to subdue. Covering the droid Vuffi Raa with an organic exterior, Whett posed as Vuffi's assistant and presented them as representatives of a galactic civilization eager to welcome the Renatasians.

By the time of rediscovery, the local inhabitants were using steel, titanium, and organoplastics, were capable of wringing useful amounts of energy from the core of an atom; and had also profitably colonized six bodies in their system. They had not yet made basic discoveries that would inviably lead to shields, tractor beams, disruptors, and disintegrators.

Whett and Vuffi Raa toured the world and helped the Renatasians form a unified world government. Then after 700 days, Whett transmitted all his data, beginning the invasion by the Imperial forces. Because of the [[Battle of Renatasia|massacre]] that followed, Vuffi Raa was nicknamed the "[[Butcher of Renatasia]]" since none of the Renatasians realized he was a droid and that Whett was the true butcher. In response, a group of the survivors had commandeered twelve aging starfighters and vowed to hunt down and kill Vuffi Raa.

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]], the [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] of Renatasia as another colony of Grizmallt is a small [[easter egg]], as ''Reina Tasia'' could come from Queen [[Elsinoré den Tasia]]. This retcon appears to contradict Vuffi Raa's statements in ''Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon'', in whic he claims the Renatasian colony is "prehistoric", long before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and "before any historian is willing to admit there was spaceflight".
